name: Scorzle
summary:
Welcome to Scorzle, a classic dice game full of fun and strategy!

Roll dice, create combos, and score points in this classic dice game created by MobilityWare!

Scorzle is a classic Yacht Dice game consisting of 13 rounds of play. It’s fun and easy to learn, and is suitable for all ages. Keep your brain sharp as you perfect your dice rolling strategy!
